# Private resident SSM composition

The private `experiments/q2-ssm-resident-fence-draft.inc` is generated by
`tools/prepare-q2-ssm-resident-draft.py --fence` from retained original Q2
source, manifest `config/q2-iq2-fixed-bounds-source.json`, SHA256
`2e81463dbbe134190c300f2b008684d584f0d75f60f36f16eb25b765c2c4b45c`.
The 1028-file source originates from independently fetched official MIT Gufo
at `f783fedb9bea2ec7de941f6da4e02f4a4596b29e`, with the previously recorded
first-party changes. Upstream MIT license and dependency notices remain.

The resident fixture derives from first-party `tests/q2_ssm_compact_lds.hip`;
the independent formula derives from first-party
`experiments/q2-ssm-row-group-oracle.inc`. Changes select the current retained
control/private composition, preserve each actual timed rotation in a distinct
state, stop on unsafe outputs, and keep wall/HIP timings separate. All added
first-party sources/tooling carry MIT SPDX markers. No DS4 or sibling-workspace
source, build artifact, model or qualified evidence is imported or modified.

The draft has no production model selector, new stream, callback or device
allocation. Runtime qualification and any later original-model integration
are separate from the preserved compiler evidence.
